outcome.detail: Actual kernel compiled clean. Allocation mutant refused: function with 'nonblocking' attribute must not call non-'nonblocking' function 'malloc'. I/O mutant refused with the same diagnostic naming 'fopen'. No mutant executed. SDK CA_REALTIME_API expands to clang nonblocking; manual rendering availability macOS 10.13 / iOS 11 and configuration notification macOS 10.10 / iOS 8 match existing ledger.

limitations: C compile-time enforcement only. Swift source-node and audio-unit render closures and upstream pullInput are outside this probe. The unit closure performs bounded buffer preparation before calling the kernel.
No runtime allocation, blocking-I/O, audio deadline, load, physical route, speaker, MIDI, or device test. The 26-family compiler without nonblocking builds unchecked.
Host Apple M5 Max, macOS 27.0 (26A425), Swift 6.4. No private inputs or output media; mutations remain under build and source is unchanged.
